% Pattern: proof/manual/article. A manual proof head in bold that names its
% statement with \ref, far from the statement, and a proof whose head uses a
% reference command of the paper.
% from 1303.4328, math/9902147
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here labels=T2
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2 status=here labels=mt:small
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 3 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want head-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=theorem-2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newcommand{\refmt}[1]{Theorem~\ref{mt:#1}}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}\label{T2} Each tree is a graph. \end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}\label{mt:small} Each path is a tree. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Each path is a graph. \end{lemma}
\begin{proof} A path is a walk. \end{proof}

\noindent {\bf Proof of Theorem \ref{T2}:}
A tree has no cycle.

\begin{proof}[Proof of \refmt{small}] A path has no cycle. \end{proof}
\end{document}
